evidence_summary.Q1: All major families exist; database/KG reader path is present but not deep enough for full architecture credit.
evidence_summary.Q2: Strong V1/V2/evolution explanation; module/property/table reference and tutorials remain incomplete.
evidence_summary.Q3: V1 concept/relation indexes and 87 V2 elements are discoverable; V2 module/property reference remains incomplete.
evidence_summary.Q4: Database overview and ontology-RDB mapping exist; no logical/physical ERD or 24-table reference catalog exists.
evidence_summary.Q5: V1/V2 evaluation and reproducibility evidence are comprehensive and bounded.
evidence_summary.Q6: Version separation, evolution, lifecycle and citation distinctions are strong.
evidence_summary.Q7: No reader-facing diagram/image/Mermaid coverage in the current Wiki pages.
evidence_summary.Q8: Home/Sidebar/cross-links and reader paths satisfy the frozen baseline checklist.
evidence_summary.Q9: Authoritative refs, evidence states, limitations and update lifecycle are strongly traceable.
evidence_summary.Q10: Some practical/reuse guidance exists, but most executable tutorial paths are absent.
evidence_summary.Q11: Publication lineage and citation/reuse guidance are complete for current status.
evidence_summary.Q12: Source QA, controlled Wiki publication/render verification, archive and lifecycle controls are operational.

evidence_summary.L1: Strong version-aware navigation and sophisticated-reader support; experience is still somewhat process-centric.
evidence_summary.L2: Professional and precise prose, but repeated template/process phrasing creates a pipeline feel on some pages.
evidence_summary.L3: Provenance is excellent, but Gate/Wave/Human Review/internal issue language is overexposed.
evidence_summary.L4: Information architecture and link discipline are very strong.
evidence_summary.L5: Evidence boundaries, negative findings, version status and non-claims are exceptionally rigorous.
evidence_summary.L6: V1, V2 and evolution narrative are coherent; internal process vocabulary interrupts the story in places.
evidence_summary.L7: Ontology overview/evolution are strong, but deep module/class/property reference coverage is incomplete.
evidence_summary.L8: Database is implemented but reader-facing DB documentation is overview-level and lacks ERDs/table catalog.
evidence_summary.L9: Reader-facing visual communication is absent in the current Wiki baseline.
evidence_summary.L10: Pages are scannable, but dense operational metadata and repeated process sections reduce progressive disclosure.
evidence_summary.L11: Versioning, QA, publication and archive automation are exemplary.
evidence_summary.L12: Research/data/application material is distinguishable, but reusable documentation-profile separation is not yet formalized.

priority_gaps: Visual documentation and formal diagram program
